description: Retrieve one Chamber catalog entry by its id, e.g. seal, try24. Read-only; returns the entry's name, price, notes, and links. Use when you know the exact entry id; use chamber_search to find an id by keyword. An unknown id returns an error listing the known ids.

id.description: Entry id within the Chamber catalog, e.g. seal, try24. Get the id list from chamber_search with an empty query; an unknown id returns an error listing the known ids.

name: chamber_get
